name: The Engineering Firm
description: Each engineer at the firm leads a different project in a different discipline. Work out who's building what.
clues: Electrical does not go with Caliper.
Watt goes with either Caliper or Welder.
Ford goes with none of Electrical, Caliper, or Oscilloscope.
Either Diesel goes with Chemical or Hertz goes with Robotics.
Oscilloscope, Welder, and Wrench go with Diesel, Watt, and Robotics, in some order.

Suppose Watt went with Oscilloscope — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Watt goes with Oscilloscope.
Watt goes with Oscilloscope, so it can't also go with Caliper.
Watt goes with Oscilloscope, so it can't also go with Welder.
…but now the clue “Watt goes with either Caliper or Welder” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Watt does not go with Oscilloscope.

From the clue “Oscilloscope, Welder, and Wrench go with Diesel, Watt, and Robotics, in some order” — Watt must go with Wrench.
Watt goes with Caliper, so it can't also go with Wrench. But Watt was already shown to go with Wrench — a contradiction.
